review.material: The official DRS publication record was read, including authors, venue and license. Its download returned HTTP 403.
review.limitations: No abstract is provided on the inspected record, and the editorial text could not be read.

evidence.description: Primary publisher record identifies Cardoso Llach and Knight and the editorial format.

sections.title: What is verified
sections.text: Cardoso Llach and Knight contributed this editorial to DRS2018. Its subject is identified by the title Design, Technology and Society; the record establishes authorship and publication context, not a checked account of its argument.

sections.title: Reading boundary
sections.text: The full editorial was not accessible through the official download in this review. No premise, methodology, test result or conclusion has been inferred from the title.

sections.title: How to use the original
sections.text: Open the official source to read its framing of the relationship among design, technology and society. Treat editorial perspectives separately from evidence reported in any research papers they introduce.
